content:
maya: seeing P99 jump ~300ms on r-gen route right after an autoscale spike, started at 12:03 UTC. Warm pool shows a lot of cold requeues and join retries.
dan: same here, throughput dropped ~2x for ~90s. /metrics shows kv_hitrate going from 0.78 -> 0.12 around the same time.
sasha: adding quick profiling snapshot + kernel selection dump:
```
kernel_score: primary=0.72 fallback=0.55
batch_size_avg: 4.2 -> 1.1
kv_hitrate: 0.12
join_latency_ms: 180
```
priya: looking at warmpool logs — warmup-hook isn't priming KV when instances are reused after preemptible eviction. see repeated requeue loop in logs:
```
[requeue] reason=warmup_timeout instance_id=i-0a1b2c
[requeue] reason=warmup_timeout instance_id=i-0a1b2c
```
infra-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up +8 GPUs at 12:02:34 UTC, provisioning_lag_median=24s
leo: hypothesis: batcher hysteresis collapses to batch size 1 during spin-up because kernel selector penalizes kernels with >0 backlog. new GPUs get fallback kernel until sequence length and kv metrics warm up — kernel_score gets temporarily biased.
maya: can we force kernel_choice override to `primary` on newly provisioned nodes and observe?
sasha: tried manual canary with ENV KERNEL_FORCE=primary on 2 nodes — p99 returned to baseline almost immediately. Patch ideas: 1) delay kernel_score penalty until kv_hitrate stabilizes; 2) add a priming job that runs a few synthetic inference requests to populate KV and warm kernels.
dan: priming job seems promising, but warmpool-respawn has a race with the eviction handler where the warmup job is sometimes cancelled. quick repro steps:
```
1) node preempted by cloud
2) warmpool allocates new node
3) eviction handler cancels initial warmup job before it completes
```
priya: i'll add a retry loop around the warmup job + a tiny jitter and bump warmup_timeout 15s -> 45s in the canary. should reduce cancellation races.
maya: rollout plan: deploy kernel_score patch to canary (2 nodes), enable priming job with retry, increase warmup timeout. monitor p95/p99, kv_hitrate, batch_size_avg across 5-minute windows.
infra-bot: Deploy started: canary nodes g-203, g-204
sasha: also adding metric `warmup_success` and an alert if success_rate < 90% over 10m — will help detect silent priming failures.
dan: postmortem action: add unit test for kernel_score hysteresis and a small sim harness to reproduce batch-collapse under spin-up.
maya: :thumbsup: i'll own the rollout + postmortem. tagging @oncall for visibility.
oncall: thanks — i'll watch the dashboards and will escalate if we see the regression recur.
